items.title: Incident: We have rats 🐀
items.body:
### Summary

A rat sneaked into the server hall and chewed through some network cables like cheese doodles at movie night. We tried to catch it, but it escaped through a TCP packet 📦. We are working on restoring the affected services.

Sorry for the inconvenience. We have no excuse, other than that the culprit was a bloody rat 🐀
